text:
maya: heads-up — saw a sharp tail-latency spike on eu-west-2 between 02:14-02:19. 95p token latency up 4x, KV cache miss rate jumped. suspect noisy warming tenant.
raj: which tenant? any allocation events?
maya: artemis-prod had a large rollout -> many short live generation jobs. logs:
```
[02:14:30] kv_cache.miss_rate=0.72
[02:15:02] gpu_util=93% per-slice
[02:16:10] latency_95=1246ms
```
jordan: that pattern matches kv cache thrash + spill to host mem. did prefetch run? pool shuffling?
maya: prefetch disabled on that slice; pool moved 2 nodes into maintenance at 02:12.
leah: hmm. we saw tenant shadowing earlier — artemis kept pinning small shards across GPUs. can we rate-limit heartbeat or warm-prefetch? :thinking: 
raj: proposal: add soft heartbeat throttle per-tenant when observed kv miss_rate > 0.5 and 95p latency > 500ms for 2m. fallback to dedicated routing if sustained 10m.
jordan: also consider pre-warm heuristic: if tenant ramp > X qps in 30s, spin up a warm slice (costy).
maya: cost tradeoff: warm slice ~ 0.018 $/min vs tail latency SLO breach. worth for customers flagged as high-priority.
leah: can we implement a short mitigation: quick kv-cache pin for 3 mins + temporary nic shaping? small config tweak.
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4493: investigate artemis warmup spikes and implement heartbeat throttle.
raj: I'll prototype throttle rule in router config, push to canary EU-WEST tomorrow morning. snippet:
```
- trigger:
    kv_miss_rate: ">0.5"
    p95_latency_ms: ">500"
    duration_s: 120
  action:
    throttle_heartbeat_pct: 60
    route_fallback_window_s: 600
```
maya: please also add metric tags and a synthetic probe that replays artemis prompt set.
jordan: adding probe + smoke test. will post results in #eng-sre.
leah: ack. if rollout looks good, we should automate warm-slice spin-up for flagged premium tenants.
maya: thanks team. ping me on pager if we see >2% SLO failures during canary. :thumbsup:
